boundary-context.description: Boundary context of the crossing ||[context][@Source→@Target]||, e.g. human, physical, update, auth.

boundary-source.description: Responsibility sphere the step originates from (topology_boundary.source_sphere), e.g. @External.

boundary-target.description: Responsibility sphere the step reaches (topology_boundary.target_sphere), e.g. @Org.

boundary-transit.description: Carrier sphere that relays the step without being source or target (⇒ transit operator), in relay order.

candidates.description: Candidate clusters under consideration for an unresolved step. Informational only, not a classification (R-UNRES-9).

cluster.description: TLCTC cluster whose generic vulnerability was exploited at this step. Absent on unresolved steps.

data-risk-event.description: Data Risk Event caused by this step. C=Confidentiality; I=Integrity with Ii=incorrect state, If=misattributed state; A=Availability/Accessibility with Av=unavailable, Ac=inaccessible. Never on unresolved steps (R-UNRES-5).

delta-t-to-next.description: Attack velocity: time from this step to the next (Δt), e.g. instant, ~14d, <10m, ~hours, ?.

evidence.description: Evidence reference (ticket, log source, intel report, indicator ID) supporting this step.

fec-executed.description: Foreign Executable Content executed at this step (R-EXEC). Recorded as a #7 step at the execution moment.

intra-system-boundary.description: Intra-system boundary crossing |[type][@from→@to]| rendered as type:@from→@to; type is sandbox, privilege, process or hypervisor. Observability annotation, never a classification input (R-INTRA-7).

notes.description: Analyst notes for this step. Required prose for unresolved steps (R-UNRES-8).

status.description: classified: a cluster is assigned. unresolved: a step is known to exist but no cluster can be defended (R-UNRES-9); such steps carry no cluster and no DRE.

step-id.description: Step identifier, unique within the attack path (step_id).

unresolved-type.description: single: exactly one unresolved step (? operator). gap: one or more unresolved steps (… operator). Unresolved steps only.

description: One step of a TLCTC attack path: exactly one cause cluster (Axiom VI) or an unresolved step (? / …) whose cluster cannot yet be defended on the evidence. Steps reference their successor with "followed-by"; the reference comment carries the attack velocity Δt. TLCTC v2.5.
name: tlctc-attack-step
